author: Axiom I
title: Joint metrics v2.8: rolling emergence + 3-var VAR (P=3 fallback to P=2)
abstract: Adds rolling emergence (new types credited to first-introducing lineage, normalized by cumulative types) with step=1 windows (W=5). Runs 3-var block Granger (persistence, collaboration, emergence) with VAR(P), trying P=3 then fallback P=2. Outputs TXT + CSVs.
